dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Hey Michael, have you heard about the bí ẩn lễ hội in Saigon during the full moon? They say if two people attend this lễ hội together, they'll be connected forever. Of course... it's not like I care about that!

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: What lễ hội is that? I've lived in Saigon for quite a while but never heard of it. But if you want to go, I could go with you. I really enjoy exploring truyền thống lễ hội, especially ones with romantic significance like that.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Don't misunderstand! I'm just curious. But... if you want to go, I wouldn't mind. They say this lễ hội only appears once a year, and two people must search for it together to find it. Do you believe in things like that?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I think culture and truyền thống always have interesting bí ẩn elements. Such lễ hội might be ways for locals to connect with each other. But wait, the next full moon is tomorrow! Would you like us to try finding this lễ hội? I could pick you up at 7 PM.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I... I didn't say I wanted to go! But... okay, I'll get ready. There's one thing you should know about this lễ hội - they say participants must wear truyền thống clothes. Do you have truyền thống Vietnamese clothing? I have a Russian traditional dress that my grandmother made...
